from dataclasses import dataclass
@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Point:
    x: int
    y: int
name, score = ("ada", 10)
_pf_t0 = (1, (2, 3))
first, _pf_t1_1 = _pf_t0
second, third = _pf_t1_1
_pf_t2 = Point(3, 4)
x = _pf_t2.x
y = _pf_t2.y
def swap(p):
    a, b = p
    return (b, a)
print(f"{name} scored {score}")
print(first + second + third)
print(x * y)
print(swap((1, 2)))
